'''Khommite striders''' were docile animals native to [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. Like the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]] themselves, the striders were [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] to preserve their genetic perfection.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> They produced [[Milk/Legends|milk]].
